gloss: after this, from now on, hereafter

definitions.explanation: From this point forward in time.
Following a specified point in time or event.

examples.english: I'll be careful from now on.

examples.japanese: 3{時|じ}{以後|いご}は{会議|かいぎ}があります。
examples.english: I have a meeting after 3 o'clock.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}{以後|いご}、{会|あ}っていない。
examples.english: I haven't seen them since graduation.

notes:
{以後|いご} indicates a time after a specified point.

USAGE:
- Can stand alone to mean "from now on"
- Can follow a time/event: X{以後|いご} (after X)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {以後|いご}: after, from now on (formal)
- {以来|いらい}: since, ever since (emphasizes continuation)
- {以降|いこう}: from ~ onward (often written contexts)
- これから: from now (conversational)
